scope: Merge owned progress, explicit unrelated retry, conflict and success post-actions, confirmed local branch removal, captured options and Stash save-to-merge-to-Pop intent. Partial parity; full application port remains incomplete.

verification.core: MergeTests: 6 passed. New real-Git unrelated-root test rejects without explicit flag, preserves HEAD on failure, then merges with two parents when flag enabled. Existing FF/no-FF/squash/no-commit/message/strategy/conflict tests passed. Merge adds optional cancellation checked before preparation and passed to final command.
verification.native: Merge progress receiver passed system Git, 2.37.1, 2.39.5 and bundled 2.55.0. Actual Merge options model captures message/options and blocks duplicate dispatch; No Commit preserves message and supplies optional Pop before Commit, retains progress until close. Local success offers Remove/Push; deletion Abort preserves ref, Delete removes ref without moving HEAD, duplicate callback blocked. Remote omits removal. Squash Commit condition, conflict Resolve/Commit/Stash target callbacks and actual unmerged index, unrelated explicit retry with two-parent merge, pre-cancellation/HEAD preservation/invalidation and original icon mapping checked. No windows, preferences or clipboard writes.
verification.regression: Stash Save progress receiver passed all four Git versions against final Sources, including captured options, created/no-change action conditions, warning/Abort/invalidation, separated staged/worktree stash parents, preserved HEAD and pre-cancellation. It does not execute the native Merge factory handoff.
verification.iterations: Initial Debug, Core and both four-Git native matrices passed. No failed compile/test iteration.
